en.headline: Centre for Food Safety finds colony count over limit in Meadows milk sample
en.dek: The affected batch of Australian UHT skimmed milk remains in the importer's warehouse and has not entered the market.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Wednesday that a sample of prepackaged UHT skimmed milk under the Meadows brand contained a colony count of 10 or more, exceeding the legal limit under the Milk Regulation.

The product, from Australia and imported by The Dairy Farm Company Limited, has a best-before date of 29 May 2027. The centre collected the sample at the import level under its routine food surveillance programme.

An investigation showed the affected batch is still stored in the importer's warehouse and has not entered the local market. The centre has informed the importer and will temporarily suspend the earlier import permission for the product. Similar products of the same brand already on the market are not affected.
A spokesman said a colony count above the legal limit indicates unsatisfactory hygienic conditions but does not mean the product would cause food poisoning.

zh.headline: 食安中心抽查Meadows脫脂奶菌落超標 產品未流出市面
zh.dek: 受影響批次的澳洲超高溫處理脫脂奶仍存於進口商貨倉，沒有流入市場。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周三表示，一個Meadows品牌預先包裝超高溫處理脫脂奶樣本的菌落計數達十個或多於十，超出《奶業規例》所定標準。
該產品來自澳洲，進口商為牛奶有限公司，此日期前最佳為2027年5月29日。中心透過恆常食物監測計劃在進口層面抽取樣本檢測。
調查顯示，受影響批次仍存於進口商貨倉，沒有流出市面。中心已通知進口商，並會暫時撤銷較早前簽發的進口准許。現時市面上同品牌同類產品不受影響。
中心發言人說，菌落計數超標顯示產品衞生情況欠理想，但不表示會引致食物中毒。
